scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.validate:client: npm run test --workspace client && npm run build:client
scripts.validate:server: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run test --workspace server && npm run build:server
scripts.validate:full: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
